blind.table_distance_name: stone bone shelf / catacomb ossuary shelf
blind.description: A stylized stone shelving unit or ossuary niche built from chunky ashlar masonry blocks. It features four shelf tiers stacked with human bones or skulls, flanked by thick stone pillars on both sides and topped with a flat stone slab edged by low raised stone borders at the back and sides. Surfaces are completely solid and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures, standing flat on the floor on its own base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular stone slab or tray with a shallow recessed surface bordered by thicker stone blocks along the ends and back lip.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft 2 in tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure), about 3.5 ft wide, and about 1.5 ft deep.
